offering_description.value: Provides mechanical, electrical and plumbing construction and building systems services for commercial, healthcare, education, industrial and government building owners. Designs, installs, and maintains HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems, primarily through contract work and recurring service.

primary_services.value: mechanical contracting; electrical contracting; plumbing installation; building systems service and maintenance; design-build services

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial building owners, developers, general contractors, data center and industrial operators; B2G: public school districts, universities, and government facility agencies

end_markets.value: commercial construction; healthcare; education; data centers; industrial; multifamily residential

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price and cost-plus contracts for installing building mechanical and electrical systems; service fees: recurring maintenance, repair and service agreements for building systems

value_chain_position.value: service provider: installs and services building systems, selling contracted labor and materials to building owners and general contractors

geography_served.value: US national: Operates offices across many US states, mainly the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, Southeast, Southwest and West

specialization.value: related lines: mechanical, electrical and plumbing contracting, plus building systems service and prefabrication

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: project bidding and negotiated contracts with owners and general contractors; own locations: regional branch offices and service centers serving local customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: contractor licensing, building codes, safety rules and environmental rules for mechanical and electrical work
